level: L3 results & analysis -- OOS cross-shape transition
scope_honesty: WITHIN-FAMILY out-of-sample: 29 Xiao periodic hills at a SINGLE Re_b=5600; NOT cross-class transfer to sharp ribs / cascades / cube arrays.  Cross-class evidence is the corpus rib LES (separate).

reconciliation.coverage_role: DEPLOYABLE a-priori gate (read from the ODE eps(s) field: model tau_w, imposed dp/ds, y_m)
reconciliation.Lsep_role: PHYSICAL explanation / severity scale (requires the converged reference separation length)
reconciliation.interpretation_diff: L_sep/delta is the NOMINALLY stronger severity orderer (|rho|=0.75 vs 0.65), but the paired bootstrap CI on the difference is [-0.18, 0.40] and does NOT exclude 0: the two are not reliably distinguishable on n=29, so coverage is a statistically comparable a-priori proxy for the reference-only L_sep/delta.

overlap_interpretation: The 4 mildest Xiao hills sit at coverage in [0.125, 0.196], BELOW the tolerated-control ceiling 0.20, yet all measure catastrophic. They share this coverage band with a real TOLERATED periodic hill (coarse krank, coverage 0.20): coverage CANNOT separate them. What does is repeating-class membership -- their L_sep/delta in [1.72, 2.64] is O(1), squarely in the O(delta)-pitch regime. Coverage is a conservative SYMPTOM of the mechanism, not the mechanism.

roc.trade_off_statement: At the locked gate cov*=0.30 the within-family recall is 0.55 but the SPECIFICITY on the tolerated controls is 1.00 (0 false positives): the gate is a SUFFICIENT condition for declaring failure, with zero false alarms.  To raise recall to 1.00 the threshold must drop to 0.125, which flags the tolerated krank periodic hill (specificity 0.92).  The gate is deliberately conservative: it never cries wolf on a tolerated geometry, at the cost of under-firing on the mildest members of an all-failure family.

transition_anchors.statement: Repetition alone does NOT trigger failure: the conv-div channel is repeating but WIDE-pitch (pitch !~ O(delta)) and is tolerated (R2=0.93, coverage 0.039); the BFS is the zero-frequency single feature and is tolerated (R2=0.89, coverage 0.043).  The 29 O(delta)-pitch hills all fail.  It is pitch ~ O(delta), not repetition or separation per se, that ignites domain-wide cancellation.

reynolds_scope: All 29 OOS cases are Re_b=5600 (B-L3-5).  The cancellation is a GEOMETRIC force balance and eps is dimensionless, so the mechanism is Re-independent to leading order; the Reynolds-asymptotic analysis (sec:reynolds) shows the catastrophe DEEPENS, not vanishes, with Re, and the scored corpus spans Re_b=5600 to Re~2e6.  A single-Re amplitude-pitch family cannot itself probe Re dependence -- stated.
